title: Tuesday Apple Rumors: 2019 iPhone Won’t Include Touch ID
text:

Breaking news sponsored by Home > Market Insight, Financial Articles > Gadgets, Smartphones & Tech > Tuesday Apple Rumors: 2019 iPhone Won’t Include Touch ID Sep 4, 2018, 1:30 pm EDT September 4, 2018 Tuesday Apple Rumors: 2019 iPhone Won’t Include Touch ID New renders give a possible look at the next iPad Pro http://bit.ly/2oMhkeV
Leading the Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) rumor mill today is news of 2019 iPhone features. Today, we’ll look at that and other Apple Rumors for Tuesday.
2019 iPhone: Apple reportedly won’t be including Touch ID in its 2019 iPhone , reports 9to5Mac . According to this rumor, the tech company is planning to stick with Face ID for the near future. There was talk that it may switch back to Touch ID with the sensors built into the display. However, this doesn’t appear to be the case. At the same time, this rumor says that many Android devices will include fingerprints scanners in the displays in 2019. The source of this rumor is analyst Ming-Chi Kuo.
iPad Pro : News images show off what the next iPad Pro may look like , BGR notes. These images are renders of the upcoming tablet. They aren’t official renders, but are instead made based on leaked CAD files of the device. As such, there’s still no way to confirm if this is what the new iPad Pro from Apple will look like. Either way, we’ll likely find out what it looks like soon at the company’s upcoming media event.
macOS Mojave Beta : A new beta of macOS Mojave is available for download , reports MacRumors . This new beta is specifically for developers, but a public beta will likely soon follow. It comes out roughly one week after the release of the ninth macOS Mojave beta. The beta is nearing its end as Apple prepares to release the new operating system update this Fall.
